# EDHT — Medical Passport: исправленная Product Bible

Редакция 2026-09-13. Сохранены все 5 175 идентификаторов. Исходные описания являются предложениями, а не свидетельством реализации или клинической валидации.

Нормативные для этой редакции ограничения и критерии: [область продукта](product/product-scope.md), [клиническая безопасность](safety/clinical-safety.md), [согласия и приватность](safety/privacy-and-consent.md), [инженерные спецификации](engineering/architecture.md). При противоречии прежних описаний применяются эти уточнения.

Оригинал сохранён отдельно как исторический источник. Принятые редакторские изменения воспроизводятся из config/editorial-corrections.json; полный журнал — data/corrections-applied.json.

## Module 2 — Project Overview

> Статус редакции: спецификация, реализация не подтверждена. Фаза: P0-specification-input. Обязательное уточнение: [границы продукта](product/product-scope.md), [безопасность](safety/clinical-safety.md), [доступ к данным](safety/privacy-and-consent.md). Направления проверки: ai-and-clinical-safety, clinical-intended-use, interoperability-and-jurisdiction.

### Project Overview

#### Purpose

Medical Passport is an international digital medical ecosystem that helps people safely travel with chronic diseases, prescription medicines and medical history.

The platform allows patients, doctors, pharmacies and emergency services to securely exchange medical information anywhere in the world.

---

#### Mission

Develop a portable medical information record. Acceptance depends on the receiving organisation, jurisdiction, verified identity, data provenance and supported interoperability profile; worldwide acceptance is an aspiration, not a present capability.

---

#### Vision

Become the global standard for secure medical information exchange.

---

#### Target Users

- Patients
- Travelers
- Doctors
- Pharmacies
- Hospitals
- Insurance Companies
- Emergency Services
- Family Members

---

#### Core Modules

- Medical Profile
- Medicines
- Diagnoses
- Allergies
- Vaccinations
- Documents
- QR Passport
- SOS
- AI Assistant
- Medical Translator
- Travel Mode
- Telemedicine
- Notifications
- Family Profiles
- Emergency Contacts

---

#### Platforms

- Android
- iPhone
- iPad
- Web

---

#### Languages

International multilingual support.

---

#### Status

Documentation Phase

## Module 3 — System Architecture

> Статус редакции: спецификация, реализация не подтверждена. Фаза: P0-specification-input. Направления проверки: ai-and-clinical-safety, clinical-intended-use.

### System Architecture

#### Goal

Define the complete architecture of the Medical Passport ecosystem.

---

### Client Layer

- Android
- iPhone
- iPad
- Web

---

### Backend Layer

P0 decision: one modular application plus worker from the same codebase, PostgreSQL and private object storage. The service names below describe logical/future capabilities, not deployed microservices. Module 51 modular-monolith MVP takes precedence; P0 excludes AI, travel, telemedicine and institutional integration. See docs/engineering/architecture.md.

- API Gateway
- Authentication Service
- Medical Service
- Documents Service
- QR Service
- AI Assistant
- Translation Service
- Telemedicine Service
- Travel Service
- Notification Service

---

### Storage

- PostgreSQL
- Object Storage (documents)
- Cache (Redis)

---

### External Integrations

- Pharmacies
- Hospitals
- Insurance Companies
- Payment Providers
- Translation Providers
- Maps
- Email
- SMS

---

### Infrastructure

- Docker
- CI/CD
- GitLab CI/CD (specification validation pipeline; application deployment is not yet implemented)
- Monitoring
- Logging

<a id="module-32"></a>

## Module 32 — QR Access Levels

> Статус редакции: спецификация, реализация не подтверждена. Фаза: P0-specification-input. Обязательное уточнение: [границы продукта](product/product-scope.md), [безопасность](safety/clinical-safety.md), [доступ к данным](safety/privacy-and-consent.md). Направления проверки: ai-and-clinical-safety, clinical-intended-use.

### QR Access Levels

#### Purpose

Defines what information is accessible through different QR access levels.

---

### Access Levels

#### Level 1 — Public

No personal or medical fields are public by default. P0 requires explicit, scoped, time-limited consent before a bearer QR holder can receive one snapshot. Identity, blood group and emergency-contact data may only be included in an explicitly selected profile scope. Recipient profession is not verified by possession of a QR.

---

#### Level 2 — Emergency

Includes Level 1 +

- Allergies

- Chronic Diseases

- Current Medicines

- Emergency Instructions

---

#### Level 3 — Doctor

Includes Level 2 +

- Diagnoses

- Medical History

- Vaccinations

- Medical Documents

- Prescriptions

---

#### Level 4 — Pharmacy

Includes

- Prescriptions

- Medicines

- Dosage

- Prescription Validity

- QR Verification

---

#### Level 5 — Hospital

Only specifically authorized record segments for the verified recipient, purpose and duration; sensitive-data restrictions remain in force.

- Documents

- Imaging

- Laboratory Results

- Diagnoses

- Medicines

- Allergies

- Vaccinations

- Insurance

---

#### Level 6 — Insurance

- Insurance Policy

- Hospital Visits

- Claims

- Billing

---

#### Level 7 — Family

User-defined access

- Medicines

- SOS

- Emergency Notifications

- Medical Profile

---

### Security

- AES-256 Encryption

- Time Limited Access

- One-Time QR

- Access Logs

- Revocable Access

- Biometric Confirmation

---

Future Features

- Dynamic QR

- Country-specific Permissions

- AI Risk Analysis

- Offline QR Verification

- Multi-factor Verification

- Digital Signature

---

Status

Documentation

---

<a id="module-33"></a>

## Module 33 — QR Access Rules

> Статус редакции: спецификация, реализация не подтверждена. Фаза: P0-specification-input. Обязательное уточнение: [границы продукта](product/product-scope.md), [безопасность](safety/clinical-safety.md), [доступ к данным](safety/privacy-and-consent.md). Направления проверки: ai-and-clinical-safety, clinical-intended-use.

### QR Access Rules

#### Purpose

Defines the rules governing QR access, permissions, expiration, and security.

---

### Access Types

- One-Time Access

- Temporary Access

- Permanent Access — excluded from P0; P0 grants require explicit scoped consent, 60–86 400-second expiry, atomic one-time use and revocation. No offline or emergency override grants in P0.

- Emergency Access

- Doctor Access

- Pharmacy Access

- Hospital Access

- Insurance Access

- Family Access

---

### Expiration

One-Time

↓

Used Once

↓

Automatically Revoked

---

Temporary

P0: one successful use, 60–86 400-second expiry; 15-minute default grant, bounded by consent expiry. Longer institutional sharing is a separate future workflow.

↓

Automatically Expires

---

Permanent

Excluded from P0. Any later delegation requires a separately specified, reviewable and revocable policy; P0 bearer sharing always expires.

---

### Permission Matrix

Doctor

✓ Medicines

✓ Diagnoses

✓ Documents

✓ Vaccinations

✓ Allergies

✓ Prescriptions

---

Pharmacy

✓ Medicines

✓ Prescription

✓ Dosage

✗ Diagnoses

✗ Documents

---

Hospital

✓ Specifically authorized record segments only; verify recipient, purpose, duration and sensitive-data policy on every access.

---

Insurance

✓ Policy

✓ Claims

✓ Hospital Visits

---

Family

User Configurable

---

### Security Rules

- AES-256 Encryption

- TLS 1.3

- JWT Authentication

- QR Token Rotation

- Device Verification

- IP Validation

- Country Validation

- Time Validation

- Access Logging

- Automatic Revocation

---

### Audit Events

QR Created

QR Viewed

QR Expired

QR Revoked

QR Shared

QR Downloaded

QR Printed

QR Validation Failed

---

Future Features

- Offline Verification

- Blockchain Verification

- Digital Signature

- Country Restrictions

- AI Fraud Detection

- Dynamic QR

- Multi-QR Profiles

---

Status

Documentation

---

### Standard Columns

P0 normative data rules: one profile per owner; medical resources reference profile_id and never accept an independent client owner ID. Use UTC timestamptz for events, calendar date for dates, integer resource versions with If-Match, enforced foreign keys and ownership checks. Distinguish unknown allergy status from none_known. See docs/engineering/data-model.md and specs/openapi.json.

id

created_at

status

## Module 54 — Authentication API

> Статус редакции: спецификация, реализация не подтверждена. Фаза: P0-specification-input. ### Authentication API

#### Purpose

Defines all authentication and authorization endpoints.

---

### Registration

P0 decision: registration, authentication, MFA and recovery are delegated to a selected OIDC provider using Authorization Code + PKCE. The custom endpoint catalogue below is retained as historical planning, not the P0 API. EDHT validates access tokens, provider session status and local account state. No server upload of biometric templates. See docs/engineering/auth-and-qr.md.

POST /auth/register

Creates a new account.

Required

- Email

- Password

- First Name

- Last Name

- Country

- Language

Returns

- JWT Access Token

- Refresh Token

- User ID

---

### Login

POST /auth/login

Authentication using email and password.

Returns

- Access Token

- Refresh Token

- Session ID

---

### Logout

POST /auth/logout

Invalidates current session.

---

### Refresh Token

POST /auth/refresh

Issues a new access token.

---

### Forgot Password

POST /auth/forgot-password

Sends password reset email.

---

### Reset Password

POST /auth/reset-password

Changes password using reset token.

---

### Verify Email

POST /auth/verify-email

Verifies email address.

---

### Change Password

POST /auth/change-password

Requires authentication.

---

### Two-Factor Authentication

POST /auth/2fa/enable

POST /auth/2fa/disable

POST /auth/2fa/verify

---

### Biometric Login

POST /auth/biometric/register

POST /auth/biometric/login

---

### Session Management

GET /auth/sessions

DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}

DELETE /auth/sessions

---

### Device Management

GET /devices

DELETE /devices/{id}

POST /devices/trust

POST /devices/untrust

---

### Response Format

{
  "success": true,
  "message": "...",
  "data": {}
}

Mission

Create the world's most trusted international medical ecosystem.

Vision

One secure medical identity for every person worldwide.

Core Values

- Privacy

- Safety

- Accessibility

- Trust

- Innovation

- International Compatibility

Strategic Goals

- International Medical Passport

- Global Healthcare Integration

- AI Medical Assistant

- Telemedicine Platform

- Pharmacy Network

- Hospital Network

- Identify a specific applicable WHO publication or programme and evaluate requirements; no generic WHO approval or compatibility is claimed.

Long-term Vision

Medical Passport becomes the global standard for secure international medical data exchange, enabling patients, doctors, hospitals, pharmacies and governments to communicate through a unified, privacy-preserving healthcare ecosystem.

- Who may access data

- Which data are shared

- Access duration

- Emergency permissions

Consent-based future access can be withdrawn through a documented workflow. Revocation must be enforced on subsequent online access. Previously downloaded, printed or offline copies cannot be remotely guaranteed to disappear; these limits and any independent lawful retention obligations must be explained.

- Family History
- Medications
- Allergies
- Vital Signs
- Growth Measurements
- Glucose Data
- Clinician Findings
- Assessment
- Recommendations
- Follow-up Plan

Example

Patient or clinician states:

"Blood pressure 124/80, pulse 78."

System proposes structured fields:

Blood Pressure: 124/80 mmHg
Heart Rate: 78 bpm

The system distinguishes patient-reported information from clinician-observed or measured findings.

All generated documentation remains editable and unpublished until clinician validation.

> Статус редакции: спецификация, реализация не подтверждена. Фаза: future-candidate. Обязательное уточнение: [границы продукта](product/product-scope.md), [безопасность](safety/clinical-safety.md), [доступ к данным](safety/privacy-and-consent.md). Направления проверки: minors-and-guardians, sensitive-data-segmentation, clinical-intended-use.

Purpose:
Measure treatment success beyond diagnostic labels using longitudinal symptoms, functioning and patient/guardian-reported outcomes.

Functions:
- Symptom Measures
- Quality of Life
- School Function
- Social Function
- Family Function Context
- Sleep
- Treatment Satisfaction Context
- Patient Goals
- Guardian Goals Context
- Clinician Goals
- Functional Recovery
- Relapse Context

Analytics:
- Baseline vs Follow-up
- Treatment-response Trajectory
- Functional Recovery
- Care Engagement
- Follow-up Completion
- Population-level De-identified Outcomes

Governance:
Population analytics require appropriate privacy, consent and de-identification controls.

Status:
Extended Module v2

## Module 5174 — Pediatric Mental Health AI, Digital Phenotype & Clinical Intelligence Module

> Статус редакции: спецификация, реализация не подтверждена. Фаза: future-candidate. Обязательное уточнение: [границы продукта](product/product-scope.md), [безопасность](safety/clinical-safety.md), [доступ к данным](safety/privacy-and-consent.md). Направления проверки: ai-and-clinical-safety, minors-and-guardians, sensitive-data-segmentation, clinical-intended-use.

Purpose:
Provide governed AI assistance for longitudinal pediatric mental-health information while maintaining strict clinical, privacy and developmental safeguards.

AI Functions:
- Timeline Summarization
- Symptom Trend Organization
- Assessment Comparison
- Medication-response Summarization
- Functional Trend Analysis
- Care-gap Detection
- Missing-data Detection
- Pre-Visit Summary
- Documentation Assistance
- Multidisciplinary Summary

Optional Future Inputs:
- Patient-reported Data
- Guardian-reported Data
- Sleep Context
- Activity Context
- Clinically Authorized Digital Measures

AI Governance:
- Human Validation
- Explainability
- Confidence/Uncertainty
- Source Traceability
- Model Version
- Pediatric Validation
- Bias Monitoring
- Drift Monitoring
- Audit Trail

Privacy:
- Sensitive-data Minimization
- Purpose Limitation
- Consent-aware Processing
- Restricted Secondary Use

Safety:
AI cannot autonomously diagnose psychiatric disease, infer undocumented trauma, prescribe medication, determine emergency disposition or make coercive-care decisions.

Status:
Extended Module v2

## Module 5175 — Clinical Pediatric Mental Health Digital Twin, Passport & Intelligence Hub

> Статус редакции: спецификация, реализация не подтверждена. Фаза: future-candidate. Обязательное уточнение: [границы продукта](product/product-scope.md), [безопасность](safety/clinical-safety.md), [доступ к данным](safety/privacy-and-consent.md). Направления проверки: ai-and-clinical-safety, minors-and-guardians, sensitive-data-segmentation, clinical-intended-use, interoperability-and-jurisdiction.

Purpose:
Serve as the master orchestration layer connecting pediatric psychiatry, psychology, behavioral health and neurodevelopment with the broader EDHT ecosystem.

Coordinates:
- Mental Health Screening
- Psychiatric Assessment
- Mental Status Examination
- Anxiety
- Depression
- Mood Disorders
- OCD
- Trauma-related Care
- ADHD
- Autism-related Mental Health
- Behavioral Disorders
- Severe Mental Illness
- Eating-related Psychiatry
- Sleep-Psychiatry
- Substance-use Care
- Psychopharmacology
- Psychotherapy
- Crisis Care
- School Function
- Family Context
- Inpatient Psychiatry
- Consent and Confidentiality
- Outcomes
- Transition Care

Digital Twin Components:
- Mental-health Timeline
- Symptom Trajectory
- Functional Status
- Treatment Exposure
- Medication Response
- Therapy History
- Crisis History
- School Function
- Social Function
- Patient-reported Outcomes

Mental Health Passport:
- Clinically Confirmed Diagnoses
- Current Medication
- Significant Medication Reactions
- Current Care Team
- Clinician-approved Crisis/Safety Information
- Communication Needs
- Relevant Functional Baseline
- Follow-up Requirements

Platform Functions:
- Unified Mental-health Timeline
- Sensitive-data Segmentation
- Granular Permissions
- Consent/Assent
- Guardian-access Management
- Medication Safety
- Therapy Coordination
- Crisis Continuity
- Outcome Monitoring
- Multidisciplinary Collaboration
- Data Provenance
- Clinical Decision Traceability
- Cross-Border Interoperability

Interoperability:
- Pediatrics
- Neurology
- Developmental Pediatrics
- Emergency Medicine
- Pharmacy
- Sleep Medicine
- Rehabilitation
- School Health where authorized
- Adult Mental Health

AI:
- Longitudinal Clinical Summary
- Treatment-response Organization
- Care-gap Detection
- Documentation Support
- Functional Trend Analysis

Future specialty foundation (not the global P0 release):
- Diagnosis Registry
- Assessment
- Mental Status
- Treatment Plan
- Medication
- Psychotherapy Record
- Crisis/Safety Plan
- Follow-up
- Consent/Assent
- Confidentiality Controls
- Guardian Permissions
- Audit Trail
- Interoperability

Expansion Layers:
- Advanced Mental-health AI
- Mental-health Digital Twin
- Remote Patient-reported Monitoring
- Multimodal Outcome Analytics
- Digital Phenotyping Research
- Population Mental-health Analytics
- International Outcomes Registries
- Research Infrastructure

Architecture Principle:
Mental-health information is part of the longitudinal health record but receives stronger privacy, consent and access controls than ordinary clinical data where clinically and legally required.

Transition Principle:
The pediatric record supports structured transition into adult mental-health services without automatically transferring information beyond applicable consent and legal requirements.

Status:
Extended Module v2
